generic_sampling_rules.integer_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_foreign_key: Sample uniformly from the parent table's generated primary-key values; include at least one NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a pool of realistic short strings; allow near-duplicate variants (case, trailing space, punctuation) for equality/LIKE targets.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a pool of realistic names; allow near-duplicate variants for equality/LIKE targets.
generic_sampling_rules.real_positive: Sample a positive real value within the observed range; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_nullable: With probability equal to the observed null rate, emit NULL; otherwise sample a positive real value within the observed range.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: With probability equal to the observed null rate, emit NULL; otherwise sample from the column's value pool.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_text: Sample uniformly from the listed enum values; include case variants for equality targets.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: 0.15 of text values are fresh (not drawn from the observed pool) to exercise DISTINCT and near-variant patterns.
